Debugging further...

Gives this, which means that drive isn't finding the entry when rclone searches for it.

```

I tried the equivalent query in [the API explorer](https://developers.google.com/drive/v2/reference/files/list) with no results also

    trashed=false and '0BzSw5cyzKmgvWi1CMXBnckJHSEE' in parents and title='GranCursos PRÓ' and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder'

Which makes me wonder if this is a bug in drive itself...

If I try with a very similar (encoding wise) unicode character it works fine

```

```

```

Which again points to a bug in drive.  I found a [possibly related stack overflow question](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/33138572/does-google-drive-rest-api-support-searching-files-in-japanese).

body: A bit more searching found that this is [a known issue in google drive](https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/64468406) which was acknowledged on 18th August 2017, so hopefully they will fix it soon.

Hi,  I also reached this error.  My tests showed that only names with upper case accents character has this error. Accents lower case character are OK!  

CONVENÇÕES   == ERROR
Convenções        == OK !

Ç  == ERROR
ç   ==  OK !


rclone  can sync or copy folders with upper case accents characters  but can not see it after copy resulting in duplicate folders names on next sync.

Important to note that gdrive ( https://github.com/prasmussen/gdrive ) can find those folders but drive (https://github.com/odeke-em/drive  ) can not.

Besides the files and folders are there, this bug are generating lots of duplicate folders and files and left a mess behind it. On some cases it is almost impossible to sync because of lots of unnecessary file transfers that are already on DRIVE.

It appears that rclone dedup can fix the mess but can take a lot to finish and the mess is made again on the syncs to come.

Please, let me know if more information is needed.

Thank you 

Roberto

It  fast become a major problem because, for some folders, it is almost impossible to sync. Rclone will transfer lots of big folders (which has upper case accents characters on it's name) instead of just a few changed files.
 
My new tests include the  --backup-dir  option and showed the following details:

issue.title: Upper case accent character in  name can not be found
issue.body:
Hello

Folder names or regular files with upper case accent character on name can not be found on drive using  name='CONSTRUÇÃO' on query.

Probably this is the same error reported on:

https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/64468406

https://github.com/ncw/rclone/issues/1675

https://github.com/odeke-em/drive/issues/955

In my tests, the folder can be listed by its parents

```
gdrive  list --query "'0BxL3iQslNxMUcm5makhoeHRWWlk' in parents   "
Id                             Name         Type   Size   Created
0BxL3iQslNxMUeWtHT29uTE5Md00   CONSTRUÇÃO   dir           2017-10-05 08:38:16
0BxL3iQslNxMUeF9vMm9pRnBYWGc   C___ção      dir           2017-10-05 08:38:15
```

But, can not be found using it's name !

```
 gdrive  list --query "'0BxL3iQslNxMUcm5makhoeHRWWlk' in parents   AND name='CONSTRUÇÃO'"
Id   Name   Type   Size   Created


gdrive  list --query "'0BxL3iQslNxMUcm5makhoeHRWWlk' in parents   AND name='C___ção'"
Id                             Name      Type   Size   Created
0BxL3iQslNxMUeF9vMm9pRnBYWGc   C___ção   dir           2017-10-05 08:38:15
```

Can be listed using contains 

```
gdrive  list --query "'0BxL3iQslNxMUcm5makhoeHRWWlk' in parents   AND name contains 'CONSTRUÇÃO'"
Id                             Name         Type   Size   Created
0BxL3iQslNxMUeWtHT29uTE5Md00   CONSTRUÇÃO   dir           2017-10-05 08:38:16
```

The gdrive version I'm using

```
gdrive version
gdrive: 2.1.0
Golang: go1.6
OS/Arch: linux/amd64
```

This problem can be repeatable using google drive  API Explorer V2 or V3

https://developers.google.com/drive/v2/reference/files/list#examples

I did not test gdrive sync command but I can tell you that both, rclone and drive programs, are severe affected on it's ability to sync  folders with upper case accent character on name. As they can not see the folder, they transfer the folder in its whole again and again at every sync command. This results on a lot of folders with the same name and content.

In my case this become impossible to sync some larger folders.

Maybe some one could help make google aware of how this strange bug on drive API are breaking the ability to sync local files on google drive.

Thank you

Roberto

issue.title: rclone creates a new directory with Cyrillic name instead of using an existing one

repository.name: rclone
repository.description: "rsync for cloud storage" - Google Drive, S3, Dropbox, Backblaze B2, One Drive, Swift, Hubic, Wasabi, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob, Azure Files, Yandex Files

issue.body:
> What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`)
rclone v1.38
- os/arch: windows/amd64
- go version: go1.9

> Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)

Windows 10 64-bit
Ubuntu 16.04.3 LTS 64-bit

> Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)

Google Drive

> The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)

rclone copy 1.mp3 "GoogleDrive:Ляпис Трубецкой"

> Log does not show anything unusual.

rclone is unable to find a path with Cyrillic symbols in it (destination or its parent) and creates new directories with duplicate names.

For instance,
> rclone copy 1.mp3 "GoogleDrive:Ляпис Трубецкой"
> rclone copy 1.mp3 "GoogleDrive:Ляпис Трубецкой"
> rclone copy 1.mp3 "GoogleDrive:Ляпис Трубецкой"

will create three directories "Ляпис Трубецкой" in root directory and reupload the file each time.

This behaviour presents in both Windows and Ubuntu.

Latin unicode names work as intended, the problem is specific to Cyrillic.
